Won't hit the market for a few years. Interested in giving it a test run?

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink) • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Prototype Smart Ammunition (100eb [Premium] per 10 rounds), which functions as Armor-Piercing, Improved Smart, and Incendiary Ammunition. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (2d6). This weapon can make Aimed Shots and use Autofire at ROF 2. When firing this weapon, if the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) during their Attack Check, they do not roll an implosion d10 [Advanced Smartlink]. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear].

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
